APPEAR FOR COURT BY COMPUTER

Please Note that some court hearings are held electronically. For these hearings you can attend via your smart phone, laptop or computer.  If you need assistance attending a hearing remotely please go to the Ada County Courthouse and stop at the information desk in the lobby.

If you have any questions please contact the Trial Court Administrator's Office at 208-287-7500.
You may enter any part of your Case # or name and search will return entries containing your search value. For example if your case number is CV01-20-98765 you could enter 9876. The more you enter the fewer the results.
